source: Cisco hash-sigs reference implementation (https://github.com/cisco/hash-sigs, C), commit cea4dda4f937e56ab42e1a74665f6397473a2838, `demo genkey <name> <h>/<w>` + `demo sign` (+ `demo advance` to reach the last leaves). One-level HSS keys: the 60-byte .pub is u32 levels=1 || LMS public key, the .sig is u32 Nspk=0 || LMS signature; both prefixes are stripped here. hash-sigs private keys are not in the RFC 8554 Appendix A form, so only public keys and signatures are recorded (no SEED). Messages are arbitrary file contents, empty to 4096 bytes.
